title: The Empty Hive
scene: At 2:15 PM, the apiary honey jar vanished. A storm covered the hives from 2:00 to 2:40.

suspects.name: Mira Cole
suspects.testimony: I was in the shed at 2:15, labeling jars.
suspects.alibiProof: The label log shows Mira's batch at 2:13.

suspects.name: Noah Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at the fence at 2:15, checking the covers.
suspects.alibiProof: The fence camera shows Noah at 2:14.

suspects.name: Olive Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the car at 2:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The car park camera shows Olive's car at 2:10.

suspects.name: Quinn Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the hives at 2:15, checking the storm covers.
suspects.contradiction: The covers were strapped shut, and honey dripped from Quinn's gloves.
